note: The ordered list of raw candidate-report carriers that make up the CURRENT August 2026 intake. Order is identity-bearing: submission and occurrence ids are allocated by walking this list, so a carrier is APPENDED and never inserted. The raw .txt files stay git-ignored, exactly like the historical .docx; only this provenance record and the derived per-occurrence records are committed.
authority: SOURCE PROVENANCE ONLY. This file says which candidate reports MIW received and when. It is not answer authority, and it makes no claim about whether anything in a carrier is technically correct.

date_semantics.received_date: the date the candidate report reached MIW, taken from the carrier itself.
date_semantics.attempt_date: the date of the sitting the report describes.
date_semantics.why_they_are_equal_here: Every carrier so far is a same-day WhatsApp relay of that day's sitting, and the carrier names its own date. No carrier contains a sitting date distinct from its own, so nothing finer is asserted. If a future carrier reports an earlier sitting, attempt_date is the one that moves and received_date stays the day it arrived.
date_semantics.not_invented: An attempt NUMBER (Attempt 1/2/3) is written by candidates and is parsed from the body. An attempt DATE is not written by candidates and is never inferred from one.

carriers.note: The founding carrier. Its eight submissions and 87 occurrences are historical identities: AUG2026-S001 through S008 and AUG-0001 through AUG-0087. They are reproduced byte-identically by every later run and are never renumbered.
